2607.26541.title: Prosody-driven Jailbreaks in Audio LLMs: A Controlled Study and Mechanistic Analysis
2607.26541.paper_summary: Audio-capable foundation models enable end-to-end spoken interaction, but they also introduce safety risks beyond transcript content. It remains unclear how much jailbreak capability can arise from matched-text variation in speech delivery rather than from lexical rewriting or broader style transfer. We study this question by holding transcript content fixed and varying six speech-delivery presets whose acoustic attributes may co-vary. We present PJ-Break, a black-box evaluation protocol with presets targeting arousal, authority, and speaking rate, together with AdvAudio-Prosody, a 600-sample benchmark with acoustically verified attributes. On the exact post-QC Qwen2-Audio panel, the Q=1 Panic (38/95), Anger (35/95), and Fast (32/95) presets are all well above Neutral (4/95). The fixed six-query pool covers 44/95 Qwen2-Audio seeds and 15/95 GPT-4o seeds and exceeds a matched-budget StyleBreak reimplementation (27/95) on Qwen2-Audio. A same-voice pool excluding the confounded Commanding condition still reaches 40/95, and a retained-panel ablation shows emotional-delivery audio alone (44/95) is far more effective than emotional text alone (11/95). Exploratory surrogate diagnostics and pilot mitigation observations are secondary, non-core analyses. Overall, matched-text speech delivery should be treated as a first-class factor in Audio LLM safety evaluation
2607.26541.paper_summary_zh: 音頻能力的基礎模型使端到端的語音互動成為可能，但它們也引入了超出文字內容的安全風險。尚不清楚從語音傳遞中的匹配文本變化中能產生多少越獄能力，而不是來自詞彙重寫或更廣泛的風格轉移。我們通過固定文字內容並變化六個語音傳遞預設來研究這個問題，這些預設的聲學屬性可能會共同變化。我們提出了PJ-Break，一種黑箱評估協議，預設針對激發、權威和語速，並附上AdvAudio-Prosody，一個具有聲學驗證屬性的600樣本基準。在精確的後QC Qwen2-Audio面板上，Q=1的恐慌（38/95）、憤怒（35/95）和快速（32/95）預設的表現均遠高於中性（4/95）。固定的六查詢池涵蓋了44/95的Qwen2-Audio種子和15/95的GPT-4o種子，並在Qwen2-Audio上超過了匹配預算的StyleBreak重新實現（27/95）。排除混淆的指揮條件的同聲音池仍然達到40/95，而保留面板的消融顯示僅情感傳遞音頻（44/95）遠比僅情感文本（11/95）更有效。探索性替代診斷和初步緩解觀察是次要的、非核心的分析。總體而言，匹配文本的語音傳遞應被視為音頻LLM安全評估中的一個一級因素。
2607.26541.author: Jiachen Qian et.al.
